newsitem.title: USA: Caribbean Cigar to distribute Regalos.
newsitem.headline: Caribbean Cigar to distribute Regalos.

text.p: Caribbean Cigar Inc said Tuesday it has signed an agreement with South Beach Cigars Inc to serve as worldwide distributor of the Regalos cigar from Honduras. The distribution agreement provides for Caribbean Cigar to be supplied with over one million Regalos cigars in 1997. The retail price of Regalos range from $5 to $16.

Caribbean Cigar that with the completion its new 32,000 foot. distribution facility, scheduled for late August, it is prepared to embark on the growing need for distribution of products in a competitive market.
